propositions: The _CASCADING_EDGES table's per-edge, same-edge guarantee does not enforce a total status ordering and permits two documented-intended residual states: in_progress child under open parent (no cascade) and blocked→in_progress resume under open parent (no cascade).

The store enforces the operator-ruled invariant 'no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket' jointly via the table's two closed-source rows and the unconditional open-children close guard in transition_close.py.

docs/concurrency.md §I4a's headline 'A child never runs ahead of its parent in the lifecycle' overstates the table's guarantee and must be narrowed to document the per-edge guarantee and the two accepted residuals.

The start-work gate fires on blocked→in_progress transitions by design, but the cascade table omits that edge; this disagreement must be resolved as documented non-cascading, with the gate and cascade reasoning documented side by side.
No transition refused today becomes permitted by this reconciliation work; the claim-status guard (txn.claim_core) and _CASCADING_EDGES table rows remain unchanged.
